name: rusty-rain
summary: Cross-platform cmatrix-style digital rain in Rust (the Windows choice). Hex colors for the rain, head and shade gradient; character groups, direction and speed flags.
configFormat: TOML (speed and custom character groups only; overrides CLI flags)

install.notes: 0.5.0, portable exe (x86_64-pc-windows-gnu build). Not in scoop.

windows.notes: Confirm `rusty-rain --version` resolves after install (portable package alias not checked). The config file is optional and, per the README, overrides CLI options: do not create it for a pane.

install.notes: No Homebrew formula found. crates.io has 0.5.1. Toolchain: `brew install rustup`.
Arch: AUR (0.5.1). No apt or dnf package found on Repology.

theme.notes: -C rain, -H head, -G shade gradient, -B background; #RRGGBB or r,g,b.

config.notes: Character group, direction, speed, shade; flags in the pane command.
